# WhereDNS 0.1

The first public release of WhereDNS combines a standalone native DNS CLI, an optional local visualization interface, and an isolated defensive-security laboratory.

## Highlights

- Inspect recursive and direct DNS queries with explanations for every section, flag, response code, and common record type.
- Trace resolution from a root server through TLD and authoritative servers.
- Choose persistent cached results or explicitly bypass the WhereDNS cache.
- Query through UDP, TCP, DNS over TLS, or DNS over HTTPS.
- Inspect DNSSEC/EDNS evidence, timings, and raw wire bytes.
- Learn nineteen DNS attack families through mechanism, prerequisites, signals, and defenses.
- Run seven safe simulations and a loopback-only authoritative lab server.
- Use the same engine through the CLI, JSON output, or embedded responsive web UI.

## Release assets

Archives are provided for Linux and macOS on AMD64/ARM64, and Windows on AMD64. Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS`.

See the [README](https://github.com/MinottiAlessandro/WhereDNS#readme) for examples, feature boundaries, and responsible-use guidance.
